notes: Attendance. Each class has an Attendance tab: everyone starts as present, so a day is one press for each student who is late, excused or absent, with a note if you want one.
Look back shows every saved day in one table with each student’s totals, and a student’s own page lists the days they missed.
Copy a day, or download the table as a spreadsheet, for your school’s system. Today has a line for it under each class.
If you don’t take attendance here, turn it off in Settings, Classes and rosters.
